name: Disneyland Bengal Barbecue "Bengal Beef" Skewer with Sweet Teriyaki Glaze
whyItWorks: Tender grilled beef sirloin cubes glazed in sweet, mild teriyaki sauce. Pure unbreaded protein cooked over an open flame with excess fat dripped away. Very gentle in remission.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Bengal Beef Skewer (specify sweet teriyaki, NOT the fiery Banyan Beef with hot sauce).
watchOuts: Do not confuse with the spicy Banyan Beef skewer
